Shardul

We could provide a link to the earlier (Distance 7.1) version of the software if you wish.  However, the current version of Distance is 7.2 and is available for download from

http://distancesampling.org/Distance/distance72download.html

Can you tell us the reason you do not wish to use the current 7.2 version?  Is there a problem with the download, with the installation, or with the execution?  All Distance projects created with earlier versions of Distance are updated when opened in Distance 7.2.  Let us know your reason for the request, should there be a problem that we need to address.
I wish to download the previous version of Distance (7.1). Is this the right place to mail?
